name: Nudge SEO AI
author: Airton Vancin Junior

sections.description:
Stop guessing what to write. Nudge SEO AI is a freemium WordPress plugin designed for smart and fast content creation. It focuses on Predictive Competitive Intelligence, analyzing top-ranking content to give you actionable suggestions (Nudges) directly within the WordPress editor.

Instead of overwhelming you with complex metrics, Nudge SEO AI tells you exactly which topics your competitors are covering so you can create more comprehensive and competitive articles.

Core Features (Free Version):

  • Competitive Topic Analysis: Extracts the key headings (H2s) from top-ranking articles to create a simple, actionable checklist.
  • Curated Analysis: Provide your own list of competitor URLs to analyze any niche with precision. If you leave it blank, the plugin uses a built-in knowledge base of high-authority SEO articles as a fallback.
  • Real-Time Nudges: As you write, the plugin checks your content against the competitor analysis and gives you “Nudges”—gentle reminders about important topics you might have missed.
  • Topic Coverage KPI: A simple progress bar shows you how your article’s structure compares to the competition, motivating you to cover all essential points.
  • Editor Integration: Works seamlessly inside the WordPress Post and Page editor (Gutenberg & Classic Editor compatible).
  • Lightweight & Fast: Designed to be blazing fast. All analysis is done via asynchronous requests, so it never slows down your writing experience.

This plugin is perfect for content creators, marketers, and SEO professionals who want to streamline their content workflow and make data-driven decisions without leaving WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nudge-seo-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any Post or Page to edit.
  4. You will find the “Nudge SEO AI” panel in the editor sidebar (or as a meta box in the Classic Editor).
  5. Enter your main keyword, optional reference URLs, and click “Obter Nudges Competitivos” to start!
sections.faq:
How does the analysis work?

When you provide a keyword and click the button, the plugin fetches the content from top-ranking articles (either from your curated list of URLs or our default list of SEO authorities). It then parses the HTML to extract the main structural headings (H2s) and identifies the most important, common topics you need to cover.

What is “Curated Analysis”?

This is a powerful feature that lets you define your own competitors. Instead of relying on a generic search, you can paste in the exact URLs of the articles you want to compete against. This gives you hyper-relevant topic suggestions tailored to your specific niche and keyword.

Do I need an API key for this to work?

No. The free version of the plugin is fully functional without any API keys. It uses WordPress’s built-in HTTP request functions to analyze publicly available content.

Is it compatible with Elementor, Divi, or other page builders?

The plugin is designed primarily for the native WordPress editor (Gutenberg and the Classic Editor). While it may work with some page builders, full compatibility is not guaranteed as they often use custom interfaces that can prevent the plugin from reading the content in real-time.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the Nudge SEO AI plugin.
  • Added the core competitive analysis engine.
  • Implemented the “Curated Analysis” feature with user-provided URLs.
  • Integrated a real-time Nudge system and Topic Coverage KPI in the WordPress editor.
  • Added CSS for a professional and clean user interface.
  • Ensured compatibility with both Gutenberg and the Classic Editor.
